notes.title: Game Update 1.3.1
notes.content: [h1]Updates and Improvements[/h1][h2]Enhancements:[/h2][list][*][p]Added feature allowing prototype research missing to take you to the Research page.[/p][/*][*][p]Added feature to allow contract cancelling.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 6 new achievements to expand awards for progress in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 contract slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new labels for Research and Prototypes, including informing the user when research/prototype creation is not possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Added feature to allow changing the game speed between 3 options.[/p][/*][*][p]Compacted and reduced the size of the game without changing the game functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed titles and text to be more meaningful after a survey and review of titles and text used in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased contract payouts to improve progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased employee training and event benefit rate.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please continue sharing your insights on our Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/vz5ZUNGND7"]https://discord.gg/vz5ZUNGND7[/url].[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: [p]Added feature allowing prototype research missing to take you to the Research page.[/p]
[p]Added 6 new achievements to expand awards for progress in the game.[/p]
[p]Added new labels for Research and Prototypes, including informing the user when research/prototype creation is not possible.[/p]
[p]Added feature to allow changing the game speed between 3 options.[/p]
[p]Compacted and reduced the size of the game without changing the game functionality.[/p]
[p]Changed titles and text to be more meaningful after a survey and review of titles and text used in the game.[/p]

tags.balance_change: [p]Increased employee training and event benefit rate.[/p]

notes.title: Game Update 1.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Updates and Improvements[/b]

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Efficiency System Overhaul: We’ve revamped the Efficiency Meter on the Overview page! Now, efficiency plays a role across all areas of the game and is affected by morale.
[/p][/*][*][p] Prototypes Bug Fix: We fixed a glitch that let two prototypes run at the same time, so that should be sorted now.
[/p][/*][*][p] Contracts Fix and Balance Update: We tackled a bug that let contract due dates go over 2000 days or even drop into the negative. Plus, we’ve rebalanced the rewards for contracts to keep things fair.
[/p][/*][*][p] New Employees Page: You’ll find a new page dedicated to employees, where you can see Team Trainings and Team Events. These features will influence morale and help with risk management. We’re also working on a third feature that will roll out in the next update!
[/p][/*][*][p] UI & Design Updates: We’ve given the game a fresh look with a redesigned menu and improved overall aesthetics.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please continue sharing your insights on our Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/vz5ZUNGND7"]https://discord.gg/vz5ZUNGND7[/url].[/p]

tags.feature: Efficiency System Overhaul: We’ve revamped the Efficiency Meter on the Overview page! Now, efficiency plays a role across all areas of the game and is affected by morale.

tags.bug: Prototypes Bug Fix: We fixed a glitch that let two prototypes run at the same time, so that should be sorted now.
Contracts Fix and Balance Update: We tackled a bug that let contract due dates go over 2000 days or even drop into the negative.

tags.balance_change: Contracts Fix and Balance Update: We tackled a bug that let contract due dates go over 2000 days or even drop into the negative. Plus, we’ve rebalanced the rewards for contracts to keep things fair.

tags.feature: New Employees Page: You’ll find a new page dedicated to employees, where you can see Team Trainings and Team Events. These features will influence morale and help with risk management. We’re also working on a third feature that will roll out in the next update!
UI & Design Updates: We’ve given the game a fresh look with a redesigned menu and improved overall aesthetics.
